card.statement:
[(i)] $D(A)|_{V^*}=A^*$.

- [(ii)]$\forall k\in\mathbb{N},\, l_1,\ldots, l_k\in V^*,\,\phi \in C^{\infty}(\mathbb{R}^k)$ define

\[
D(A)\left[\phi(l_1,\ldots,l_k)\right]:=\sum\limits_{m=1}^k \frac{\partial\phi}{\partial x_m}(l_1,\ldots,l_k)A^*l_m
\]

- [(iii)] Let $\mu$ be a Radon Gaussian measure on the space $V$ and $H(\mu)\subset V$ be the Cameron-Martin space of $\mu$. For general $f\in L^2(V, d\mu)$ we define

\[
D(A)f(x):=\lim\limits_{t\to 0}\frac{f(x+tAx)-f(x)}{t}, x\in V,
\]

whenever limit exists. Note that whenever $f$ is a cylindrical function this definition coincides with (ii). By the density of the set of cylindrical functionals in $L^2(V,d\mu)$ and Cauchy-Schwartz inequality we can extend $D(A)$ to the Sobolev space $W^{4,1}(\mu)$ (see, for instance, <<cite:Bogachev98>>), for all $A$ such that

\[
\int\limits_V |Ax|_{H(\mu)}^4d\mu<\infty.
\]
card.label: Definition 15

paper.title: Convex topological algebras via linear vector fields and Cuntz algebras
paper.abstract: Realization by linear vector fields is constructed for any Lie algebra which admits a biorthogonal system and for its any suitable representation. The embedding into Lie algebras of linear vector fields is analogous to the classical Jordan-Schwinger map. A number of examples of such Lie algebras of linear vector fields is computed. In particular, we obtain examples of the twisted Heisenberg-Virasoro Lie algebra and the Schrödinger-Virasoro Lie algebras among others. More generally, we construct an embedding of an arbitrary locally convex topological algebra into the Cuntz algebra.
